 Upstream support for Oracle 12.1 ends in July 2021. Django 2.2 will be
 supported until April 2022. Django 3.0 officially supports Oracle 12.2 and 18c.
 
+New default value for the ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` setting
+-------------------------------------------------------------
+
+In older versions, the :setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` setting defaults to
+``None``. Uploading files without an explicit value set for this setting
+could result in inconsistent permissions for uploaded files, depending on the
+upload handler used, e.g. permissions could end up being as strict as
+``0o600`` for temporary files that are moved to the destination location, or
+follow the current umask setting for files that stream directly to the
+destination.
+
+``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` now defaults to ``0o644`` to avoid this
+inconsistency.
+
